endorsements.quote: Furthermore, real-world user studies serve as the gold standard for evaluation.

Additionally, the interdependence of system components means that changes to one element can impact the overall performance, necessitating rigorous testing and calibration whenever modifications are made.

In practice, the efficacy of RAG relies on two aspects: (1) the quality of the external database, which should be high-quality and up-to-date 36 , 37 , and (2) the performance of the retrieval systems, which are responsible for identifying and extracting the most relevant content to supplement the LLM’s output 38 , 39 .
To maintain transparency and enable verification, LLM-generated outputs should include references to the original content, allowing users to identify and correct any potential misinformation.

unlisted_practices: Use domain-specific evaluation metrics tailored to medical professional standards, such as completeness, correctness, and conciseness, rather than general NLP metrics like ROUGE or BERTScore, and design them collaboratively with medical practitioners.
De-identify PHI from training data of medical LLMs.
Implement access controls within AI applications so users can only access datasets relevant to their queries.
Prevent LLM applications from inadvertently disclosing one user's data to another.
Use synthetic training data protected with differential privacy when real data cannot be acquired.
Maintain regulatory compliance of AI applications over time through ongoing monitoring, documentation, and potential re-certification as models are updated and retrained.
Build robust development datasets from real-world tasks or simulated scenarios for evaluating and finetuning AI pipelines.
Collect user feedback and interaction logs for continual optimization of AI pipelines.
